```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(bslib)

df <- ggplot2::diamonds
diamond_grade_colors <- c(
  D = "#F4F8FB", E = "#E1EDF4", F = "#C9DDE8",
  G = "#B8CED0", H = "#D9C99F", I = "#D8A84E", J = "#B87925"
)
```

# Overview

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("cut", "Diamond Cut", choices = c("All", levels(df$cut)))
sliderInput("carat", "Carat Range", min = 0, max = 5,
            value = c(0, 5), step = 0.1)
checkboxGroupInput("color", "Diamond Color Grade",
                   choices = levels(df$color), selected = levels(df$color))
radioButtons("clarity", "Clarity", choices = c("All", levels(df$clarity)))
numericInput("price", "Maximum Price ($)", value = 20000, min = 0)
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
value_box(title = "Diamonds in View", value = textOutput("total_diamonds"),
          showcase = icon("gem"), theme = "primary")
```

```{r}
value_box(title = "Average Price", value = textOutput("average_price"),
          showcase = icon("sack-dollar"), theme = "success")
```

# Data

## Filtered Diamond Dataset

```{r}
DTOutput("diamonds_table")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

filtered <- reactive({
  data <- df |>
    filter(carat >= input$carat[1],
           carat <= input$carat[2],
           color %in% input$color,
           price <= input$price)
  if (input$cut != "All") data <- data |> filter(cut == input$cut)
  if (input$clarity != "All") data <- data |> filter(clarity == input$clarity)
  data
})

output$total_diamonds <- renderText({
  nrow(filtered())
})

output$average_price <- renderText({
  data <- filtered()
  if (nrow(data) == 0) "No matches" else scales::dollar(mean(data$price), accuracy = 1)
})

output$price_hist <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = price)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 35, fill = "#2A9D8F", color = "white") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "How prices are distributed", x = "Price", y = "Number of diamonds") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
})

output$carat_price <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = carat, y = price, color = color)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = diamond_grade_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Price tends to rise with carat weight", x = "Carat", y = "Price", color = "Grade") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
})

output$carat_hist <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = carat)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#457B9D", color = "white") +
    labs(title = "Carat weight distribution", x = "Carat", y = "Number of diamonds") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
})

output$cut_price_box <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = cut, y = price, fill = cut)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.18) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Price spread by cut", x = "Cut", y = "Price") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$color_count <- renderPlotly({
  counts <- filtered() |> count(color)
  ggplotly(ggplot(counts, aes(x = color, y = n, fill = color)) +
    geom_col(color = "#52616B", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diamond_grade_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Diamonds by color grade", x = "Color grade (D is most colorless)", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$clarity_count <- renderPlotly({
  counts <- filtered() |> count(clarity)
  ggplotly(ggplot(counts, aes(x = clarity, y = n, fill = clarity)) +
    geom_col() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
    labs(title = "Diamonds by clarity", x = "Clarity", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$avg_by_color <- renderPlotly({
  averages <- filtered() |> group_by(color) |> summarize(avg_price = mean(price), .groups = "drop")
  ggplotly(ggplot(averages, aes(x = color, y = avg_price, fill = color)) +
    geom_col(color = "#52616B", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = diamond_grade_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Average price by diamond color grade", x = "Color grade", y = "Average price") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$avg_by_cut <- renderPlotly({
  averages <- filtered() |> group_by(cut) |> summarize(avg_price = mean(price), .groups = "drop")
  ggplotly(ggplot(averages, aes(x = cut, y = avg_price, fill = cut)) +
    geom_col() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Average price by cut", x = "Cut", y = "Average price") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$avg_by_clarity <- renderPlotly({
  averages <- filtered() |> group_by(clarity) |> summarize(avg_price = mean(price), .groups = "drop")
  ggplotly(ggplot(averages, aes(x = clarity, y = avg_price, fill = clarity)) +
    geom_col() + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Average price by clarity", x = "Clarity", y = "Average price") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$cut_clarity_box <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = cut, y = price, fill = clarity)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.12) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Price ranges by cut and clarity", x = "Cut", y = "Price", fill = "Clarity") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
})

output$carat_price_log <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = carat, y = price, color = color)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.5) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "#E76F51", se = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = diamond_grade_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
    labs(title = "Carat and price relationship", x = "Carat", y = "Price (log scale)", color = "Grade") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
})

output$carat_cut_violin <- renderPlotly({
  ggplotly(ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = cut, y = carat, fill = cut)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.8, trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.alpha = 0.12, fill = "white") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(title = "Carat weight distribution by cut", x = "Cut", y = "Carat") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "none"))
})

output$diamonds_table <- DT::renderDT({
  DT::datatable(filtered(), options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
})
```
